basic_info.description: Situated on the picturesque northslope of Potrero Hill, this exquisite residence within a 2-unit building boasts an abundance of natural light creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the open kitchen, living and dining area. The thoughtfully designed layout is the ideal setting for both entertaining and daily living. The kitchen features ample storage space, a 6-burner gas range, stainless steel appliances, plus a wine fridge. The beautifully appointed bedrooms offer serene views of the tranquil rear garden oasis, providing a peaceful retreat at the end of each day. The home includes a dedicated large storage room, shared rear garden, a washer and dryer and a side-by-side parking space in the garage. Additionally, from this prime location, you'll be treated to breathtaking downtown views that are truly jaw-dropping. Experience the perfect blend of urban convenience near shopping and parks, and quiet serenity with this remarkable property.
